example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কথা শুনে কপট ঘুম করে শুয়ে পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: The children feigned sleep when they saw their mother.
He pretended to be asleep upon hearing the conversation.
history: The idiom originates from the observation that crows sleep lightly and remain alert, symbolizing pretended or superficial sleep in Bengali folklore.
note: The idiom draws from natural behavior of crows, common in rural Bengali expressions.
